result.summary: This PR adds functional test coverage for the case where BlockWaitOptions.feeThreshold is set to MAX_MONEY in the IPC mining interface's waitNext(), i.e. when a client wants only tip updates and not fee-increase updates. It was split out of #33922 because the author decided that PR's memory-tracking work was a distraction from adding this pre-existing behavior coverage, and it might land far in the future. The test and a small ipc_util.py helper change went through several rounds of correctness fixes from reviewers pointing out timing subtleties in wait_and_do and mempool state.
result.problem: The waitNext() MAX_MONEY fee-ignore behavior was previously untested, so a regression in that path would go unnoticed; this affects consumers of the mining IPC interface such as Stratum v2 template providers.

resolved_concerns: davidgumberg found the original test didn't actually exercise the fee-threshold skip due to timing; author adjusted timeouts and added sleep_time parameter to wait_and_do.
davidgumberg suggested adding a transaction to verify MAX_MONEY prevents fee-based updates; author incorporated with adjustments.
jeanpablojp noted a comment inaccuracy and suggested asserting CreateNewBlock() is not called for MAX_MONEY; author adopted the suggestion.
enirox001's nit about existing mempool tx already satisfying threshold before wait_and_do call was addressed by removing the redundant wait_and_do and adjusting the debug log message.

result.card: This PR adds functional test coverage for the mining IPC waitNext() interface's feeThreshold = MAX_MONEY behavior, where an IPC client wants only tip updates and not fee-increase updates. It was split out of #33922 by the author because that PR's memory-tracking work made this coverage a distraction, and splitting it lets both PRs get focused review. During review, davidgumberg, jeanpablojp, and enirox001 each found real timing or logic gaps that let the test pass without actually exercising the intended behavior, and the author fixed each round; the latest reviews are ACKs with only non-blocking nits. The change is purely test code plus a minor test-framework helper addition (sleep_time parameter to wait_and_do), with no functional or interface changes. It is ready for merge pending maintainer action.
